speaker: Doctor
text:
The clinical picture of a 4-year-old with fever, fatigue, bruising, and severe bone pain, combined with a Complete Blood Count showing anemia, thrombocytopenia, and leukocytosis, is highly suggestive of a hematologic malignancy. The Bone Marrow Aspirate findings of immature blasts positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT are diagnostic for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)
